title: A restart-free accelerated algorithm for nonconvex minimization: continuous- and discrete-time analysis
summary: We propose two deterministic momentum-based first-order methods for minimizing lower-bounded nonconvex functions with Lipschitz-continuous gradients and Hessians. Both methods attain an $\varepsilon$-approximate first-order stationary point in $O(\varepsilon^{-7/4})$ function and gradient evaluations, and their update parameters do not depend on the target accuracy or a prescribed terminal iteration. The convergence guarantees concern the best point among weighted averages of the iterates. Instead of relying on momentum-resetting restarts, both methods employ a velocity-control mechanism…
